Input UI components for the alphafoldConfidence module

Source: R/alphafoldConfidence_module_ui.R
alphafoldConfidenceInputsUI.Rd

This should be placed in the UI where the inputs should be shown, with an id that matches the id used in the alphafoldConfidenceServer() and alphafoldConfidenceOutputUI() functions.

Usage

alphafoldConfidenceInputsUI(
  id,
  data,
  defaults = NULL,
  title = "AlphaFold Confidence Settings",
  columns = 2
)

Arguments

id

The ID for the Shiny module.

data

An object from read_alphafold().

defaults

A named list of default values for the inputs.

title

An optional title for the UI grid.

columns

Number of columns for the UI grid.

Value

A Shiny tagList containing the UI elements

Details

The module draws alphafoldConfidence() for an object from read_alphafold(): the per-residue pLDDT over the AlphaFold DB confidence bands, and the predicted aligned error heatmap on the same residue axis. The inputs are organised into tabs via VizModules::organize_inputs().

Plot parameters and defaults

The following parameters can be accessed via UI inputs and/or the defaults argument:

  • residue.start, residue.end - Range of positions to show (default: all)

  • max.pae - Top of the PAE colour scale in Angstroms (default: the file's maximum)

  • show.bands - Shade the pLDDT confidence bands (default: TRUE)

  • show.chains - Mark chain boundaries (default: TRUE)

  • track.height - Fraction of the height given to the pLDDT track (default: 0.25)

  • line.color - pLDDT line colour (default: "#333333")

  • band.very.high, band.confident, band.low, band.very.low - Band and marker colours (default: the AlphaFold DB colours)

  • pae.low.color, pae.high.color - PAE colours at zero and at max.pae (default: dark green to white, as AlphaFold DB)

The Legend, Axes and Plotly tabs carry the shared VizModules inputs.

See also

alphafoldConfidence(), read_alphafold(), alphafoldConfidenceOutputUI(), alphafoldConfidenceServer(), alphafoldConfidenceApp()

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
af <- read_alphafold(
    pae = system.file("extdata", "AF-P04637-F1-predicted_aligned_error_v6.json.gz",
        package = "sciVizModules"),
    confidence = system.file("extdata", "AF-P04637-F1-confidence_v6.json.gz",
        package = "sciVizModules")
)
alphafoldConfidenceInputsUI("af", af)
